title: Nice quality towels for your bath
text: Nice quality towels for your bath. I really liked this towel set. Well made, soft, absorbent, these towels are great. If there was anything to deduct a star for, it's for the 8 piece set. Typically, I use mostly bath towels and washcloths. In my opinion, this 8 piece set is a bit of overkill (and if I wanted a set of 4-6 of these, I wouldn't have the space for all of the sizes). Outside of that, these are great towels and can absorb a lot of water. They hold up well with repeated washings, too, with no fading. This rich pebble color is a great neutral one and will blend with most colors in your home. Highly recommend!

product_metadata.title: Luxus Premium 100% Cotton 8 Piece Towel Set (Pebble) - Supersoft - Highly Absorbent - Quick Dry - Hotel Spa Bathroom Towel Collection - 2 Bath Towels - 2 Hand Towels - 4 Wash Towels
features: Set includes two bath towels (30 inch x 54 inch), two hand towels (16 inch x 30 inch), and four washcloths (13 inch x 13 inch). These truly indulgent towels are available in a wide variety of beautiful colors to suit any home or hotel bathroom.
Towel density is 450 grams per square meter (GSM). The weight of a towel is a great indicator of quality and performance. This 450 GSM-density towel will soak up water fast for noticeable absorbency.
Woven with 100% cotton, these towels are soft and durable as well as high in absorbency. This towel is bound to add an element of charm and uniqueness to your bathroom.
Oeko-Tex: made in green, which means our towels are tested for harmful substances and are produced sustainably.
Wash Instructions: Machine wash warm with delicate cycle with like colors. Tumble dry low. Do not bleach. Do no dry clean. Do not iron.
